column1: # Accepted GPL-only files of the contribs (check-no-gpl.sh, section H).
# PACKAGE-GLOB <TAB> PATH-REGEX (relative to the package directory) <TAB> justification
# The package directory is the one of VLC's contrib build (contrib-android-<tuple>/<name>/).
# An entry only matters for a file that is compiled AND a member of an installed static
# library (scripts/audit_licenses.py contribs); keep this list short and justified.

column3: Test programs, examples, documentation tools and demos: built only by "make check" or on request, never archived in an installed library.
libpng's contrib/ (gregbook example viewers): sample programs, not part of libpng.
FLAC command-line programs, their tests and helper convenience libraries (libgrabbag, utf8); libFLAC itself is src/libFLAC (BSD).
GnuTLS command-line tools (gnutls-cli, certtool, ...) and the gnulib code they use; libgnutls is lib/ (LGPL-2.1+).
libgnutls-openssl (GPL by design), built only with --enable-openssl-compatibility, off in the contrib.
asn1Parser/asn1Coding/asn1Decoding tools and the gnulib they use; libtasn1 itself is lib/ (LGPL).
The iconv program and its gnulib; libiconv.a is lib/ and libcharset/ (LGPL).
Random-number daemon helpers (--enable-random-daemon, off); not part of libgcrypt.
nfs-ls, nfs-cat, ... command-line utilities, not part of libnfs.
fribidi command-line program (getopt copy); the library is lib/ (LGPL-2.1+).
Generator program run by the developers to produce the twofish tables; not compiled into libnettle.
Windows-only experimental transcoder; not built for Android.
